workflows.title: Research ideation with Idea Spark
workflows.summary: Generate one literature-grounded, reviewer-defensible and implementable research idea through the canonical Idea Spark workflow.

workflows.title: Dynamic multi-model task execution
workflows.summary: Use the strongest visible Codex host model to author a fresh Mastra dynamic workflow, then dispatch bounded Codex and MiniMax workers.

components.title: Plan and run a dynamic multi-model workflow
components.summary: Discover the strongest host Codex planner, validate its Mastra dynamic graph, and execute bounded Codex or MiniMax workers.

components.title: Prepare Idea Spark request
components.summary: Validate a scoped typed execution grant, then digest-bind the scientific request and isolated Idea Spark run directory.

components.title: Run one explicit Idea Spark stage
components.summary: Advance exactly one literature, bottleneck, candidate, coherence/collision, gauntlet, or packaging boundary with heartbeat telemetry.

components.title: Verify retrieval provider status
components.summary: Derive provider status from immutable retrieval evidence and fail closed against the grant's literature or collision policy.

components.title: Decide bounded Idea Spark retry
components.summary: Map the authoritative Idea Spark navigator to a typed candidate retry, bottleneck re-diagnosis, packaging, failure, or terminal route.

components.title: Apply Idea Spark retry transition
components.summary: Apply exactly one archived candidate retry, bottleneck re-diagnosis, or terminal failure transition emitted by Idea Spark.

components.title: Verify Idea Spark terminal
components.summary: Verify the terminal navigator state and digest every required Idea Spark output artifact.

components.title: Evaluate factor evidence
components.summary: Classify committed backtest evidence without changing campaign state.

components.title: Freeze experiment identity
components.summary: Freeze baseline, evaluator, dataset, horizon, cost model, and experiment identity before execution.

components.title: Generate factor candidate
components.summary: Propose one bounded factor or strategy candidate for an experiment.

components.title: Factor iteration policy
components.summary: Propose the next generation plan from committed campaign evidence.

components.title: Run factor backtest
components.summary: Execute one idempotent offline strategy backtest.

components.title: Factor strategy child workflow
components.summary: Invoke a bounded factor experiment child component from a campaign.

components.title: Validate factor candidate
components.summary: Apply deterministic feasibility checks to a proposed factor candidate.

components.title: Aggregate research ideas
components.summary: Merge validated branches and remove duplicate research candidates.

components.title: Audit research idea
components.summary: Audit evidence and claims for one research idea branch.

components.title: Check idea coherence
components.summary: Check whether a research idea is internally coherent.

components.title: Check idea collision
components.summary: Check novelty collisions and overlap with existing research directions.

components.title: Freeze research brief
components.summary: Freeze the research brief and fan it out to independent idea branches.

components.title: Generate research idea
components.summary: Generate one bounded research idea from a frozen brief.

components.title: Check implementability
components.summary: Check whether a research idea can be implemented with available resources.

components.title: Campaign activation policy
components.summary: Validate and activate a frozen iterative campaign.

components.title: Campaign budget policy
components.summary: Evaluate frozen experiment, retry, and total-node budgets.

components.title: Campaign decision policy
components.summary: Commit one declared decision edge from a valid Frame Assessment.

components.title: Campaign Frame Check
components.summary: Assess whether the goal, evaluator, evidence, and abstraction frame remain valid.

components.title: Terminal receipt contract
components.summary: Validate the terminal result contract for bounded flows and campaigns.

components.title: Campaign wait state
components.summary: Represent a wakeable waiting state without transferring campaign authority to a scheduler.

runtimes.title: Mastra bounded-flow adapter v0
runtimes.summary: Translate the supported bounded-flow subset into executable Mastra workflows when exact executors are bound.
limitations: Rejects iterative campaigns, join:any, failure routes, human suspension, and non-idempotent writes.
Run-local receipts and worker heartbeats are append-only, but the adapter has no durable Mastra checkpoint and is not connected to the campaign ledger.

runtimes.title: Summer campaign core v0
runtimes.summary: Validate iterative-campaign state transitions with an append-only in-memory authority ledger.
limitations: No durable storage, lease fencing, scheduler, or campaign worker is implemented.
Campaign policy descriptors in the fixture registry have no executor bindings.
